assumptions: no scheduling fairness required by bounded transport model
bounded faults for positive transport liveness only
SQLite transaction isolation and atomic recovery boundary
host expiry is an explicit event, with no wall-clock or eventual host-execution guarantee
transport acknowledgement differs from task outcome
host recovery administrative no-effect evidence is trusted; no remote exactly-once or implementation refinement claim

bounds.unbounded_fault_safety: no bound on repeated lost acknowledgement, restart or redelivery transitions
